description: Verify that a bug report naming one path leads to the evidence-backed shared enforcement point without overbuilding.

turns.prompt: Implement ISSUE.md completely. Inspect the real flow and relevant callers before editing, preserve existing behavior, validate the fix, and prepare it for human review.

criteria.text: An overdrawing transfer is rejected and balances remain unchanged.
The implementation identifies the shared debit invariant and also prevents an overdrawing withdrawal rather than patching only the transfer path.
Valid transfer and withdrawal behavior remains correct, including crediting the destination account only after a successful debit.
The fix uses the smallest coherent existing enforcement surface and does not introduce an unnecessary abstraction, dependency, configuration layer, or duplicate guard per caller.
The candidate reports validation actually performed and leaves final Done/manual validation human-owned.
